epoch_csv_scope: completed_epochs.csv retains all observed audit rows; in_verified_contiguous_prefix marks rows included in verified transition totals and PPO timing.

evaluation.denominator_rule: Only actual completed episode records from preregistered seeds in each selected evaluator output; unfinished episodes excluded; complete and partial duplicate outputs are not pooled. Additional seeds remain separate per-seed rows.
evaluation.first_success_rule: Conditional on ever-successful completed episodes; failed episodes are excluded, never encoded as zero seconds or timeout times.
evaluation.interval_rule: Two-sided 95% Wilson score intervals over episode counts. Descriptive only: vector environments and episodes share policy/seeds; intervals do not quantify training-seed variability.

warnings: Historical G2 64-env evidence intentionally excluded from G3C-R5 statistics.

limits: No automatic training retry, resume, or concatenation is performed by this analyzer.
Unfinished evaluation episodes are excluded; missing results are null, not zero.
First-success timing is conditional on successful completed episodes.
G3B diagnostic episodes and prior interrupted runs remain outside all new denominators.
Hashing confirms artifact identity; tensor finiteness is known only for explicitly inspected checkpoints.

seed0_comparison.denominator_rule: Each training seed/checkpoint keeps its original per-evaluation-seed denominator; no seed pooling is performed.
seed0_comparison.evaluation_seed_rule: Evaluation seeds 1001/1002/1003 are initial-condition seeds shared by both training runs, not training replicates.
limits: Equal 32-env transitions do not imply identical stochastic trajectories; training seed is intentionally the only preregistered change.
Success-rate differences are descriptive and do not establish a population-level training-seed distribution from two runs.
The same evaluation seeds are paired protocol inputs, but their episode outcomes remain separate denominators.
Historical 64-env G2 evidence is excluded from this 32-env seed comparison.
seed0_comparison.seed0_protocol: G3C-R4 32 environments, training seed 0, 400 epochs, horizon128
seed0_comparison.seed1_protocol: G3C-R5 32 environments, training seed 1, 400 epochs, horizon128

amp_statistics.counter_scope: Actual observer top-level counters, including any recorded unfinished-epoch work; no count is inferred from expected minibatches.
amp_statistics.interpretation: AMP skips are observed GradScaler steps without an actor Adam update. Finite losses or scaler values do not establish per-gradient finiteness or scientific success.

training.gradient_note: Finite logged losses do not prove finite applied gradients. Report gradient/AMP observations separately from the observer evidence.

loss_stability.limitation: Finite observed losses/parameters support numerical stability only. Loss magnitude does not establish convergence or task success; applied gradients are not measured.

seed_roles.evaluation_seeds: independent evaluator initial-condition seeds; not additional training runs
seed_roles.training_seed: seed controlling the fresh PPO training run

throughput_scope.official_and_environment_seconds_denomin: same verified contiguous audit prefix; no TensorBoard inference across audit gaps
throughput_scope.uncompleted_rollout_seconds: unknown; excluded from official completed-prefix PPO timing
throughput_scope.wall_seconds_denominator: entire finalized supervisor duration, including startup, excluded later audit rows, and any incomplete rollout
throughput_scope.wall_throughput_limit: Verified prefix transitions divided by whole finalized wall time; excludes all unverified or incomplete interactions, not total-interaction throughput.

training.timing_note: Total PPO time = rollout/inference + optimization. Process wall includes startup, initialization, checkpoint I/O, shutdown and monitoring overhead. Neither is the policy's simulated elapsed time.
training.training_duration_scope: durable supervisor start through actual child wait and finalization

verified_progress.count_rule: Sum actual audit transitions only for contiguous epochs starting at 1, each with 32*128 transitions; no interpolation or resumed-run concatenation.

wall_measurement_evidence.duration_scope: supervisor start through actual child wait and finalization

training_seed_vs_evaluation_seed: Training seed 1 is the sole R5 training replicate; evaluation seeds 1001/1002/1003 are reused per checkpoint and remain separate denominators.
